reference_sql:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT channel_id, spend,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend DESC, campaign_id) AS rn
  FROM campaign_spend
)
SELECT channel_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 2 THEN spend ELSE 0 END) AS top2_spend,
       SUM(spend) AS channel_spend,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 2 THEN spend ELSE 0 END) / SUM(spend), 2) AS top2_share_pct
FROM ranked
GROUP BY channel_id

WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
top2 AS (  -- one row per campaign among the 2 biggest of its channel
  SELECT cs.channel_id, cs.spend
  FROM campaign_spend cs
  WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_spend cs2
         WHERE cs2.channel_id = cs.channel_id
           AND (cs2.spend > cs.spend OR (cs2.spend = cs.spend AND cs2.campaign_id < cs.campaign_id))) < 2
),
top2_total AS (  -- one row per channel with spend
  SELECT channel_id, SUM(spend) AS top2_spend
  FROM top2
  GROUP BY channel_id
),
channel_total AS (  -- one row per channel with spend
  SELECT channel_id, SUM(spend) AS channel_spend
  FROM campaign_spend
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT ct.channel_id, tt.top2_spend, ct.channel_spend,
       ROUND(100.0 * tt.top2_spend / ct.channel_spend, 2) AS top2_share_pct
FROM channel_total ct
JOIN top2_total tt ON tt.channel_id = ct.channel_id

solver.query:
WITH camp AS (
  SELECT c.channel_id, c.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.campaign_id
),
r AS (
  SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend DESC, campaign_id ASC) AS rn,
         SUM(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id) AS channel_spend
  FROM camp
)
SELECT channel_id,
       SUM(spend) AS top2_spend,
       MAX(channel_spend) AS channel_spend,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(spend) / MAX(channel_spend), 2) AS top2_share_pct
FROM r
WHERE rn <= 2
GROUP BY channel_id
